note: Migrate File To Media Example is a worked example submodule of migrate_file_to_media. Enabling it installs an Article content type with image fields field_image and field_image2 (via config/optional) and three migrate_plus migrations (via config_devel), migration group 'media': step1 (source media_entity_generator, fields field_image+field_image2, toggle_media_mapping:true) creates deduped media entities; step1_de adds translations; step2 (source content_entity:node, process file_id_lookup) populates field_image_media/field_image2_media on the Articles. A step1_rokka variant demos the rokka.io CDN. It is a copy-me template, not for production. The medium case inspects the shipped step1 migration config; the hard case creates the two media reference fields (field_image_media, field_image2_media) the step2 migration writes into.

evals.prompt: What does the migrate_file_to_media_example submodule provide, and what is the id of its step-1 migration?
evals.expected_output: It is a worked example that installs an Article content type with image fields and three migrate_plus migrations. The step-1 migration id is migrate_file_to_media_example_article_images_step1 (which creates the media entities); step 2 links them back onto the Articles.

evals.prompt: Which image fields on the Article content type does the migrate_file_to_media_example step-1 migration convert to media?
evals.expected_output: The example migrates the Article image fields field_image and field_image2 (listed under the media_entity_generator source's field_names).

evals.prompt: In the migrate_file_to_media_example, which migrate source plugin does step 1 use, and how does step 2 attach the created media entities back onto the Article nodes?
evals.expected_output: Step 1 uses the media_entity_generator source to create the media entities; step 2 uses the content_entity:node source with the file_id_lookup process plugin to set field_image_media / field_image2_media on the Articles.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the migrate_file_to_media_example module is installed. Inspect the live configuration of its step-1 migration (migrate_file_to_media_example_article_images_step1) and report the migrate source plugin it uses.
evals.expected_output: The step-1 migration's source.plugin is media_entity_generator (drush cget migrate_plus.migration.migrate_file_to_media_example_article_images_step1 source.plugin).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, prepare the Article content type for the migrate_file_to_media_example step-2 migration by creating the two media reference fields it writes into: field_image_media and field_image2_media (each an entity reference to the image media type), mirroring the existing field_image and field_image2 image fields. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Run drush migrate:file-media-fields node article image image (the migrate_file_to_media command that creates a <field>_media entity_reference field per image field), which creates field_image_media and field_image2_media on Article targeting the image media type; or create those two entity_reference fields manually.
